Consider the vector field $F(x,y)$ shown above, and let $C$ be the path along the quarter circle traversed from $A$ to $B.$ Which of the following statements are true?

- ${\int }_{C}F\cdot \text{d}r>0$
- ${\int }_{C}F\cdot \text{d}r=0$
- ${\int }_{-C}F\cdot \text{d}r<0$
